segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Good morning, children. Today we will read together. Please take out your English reader, the story called The Little Bird. Sit with your reading partner.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Good morning, sir.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Remember our rule. One child reads one line, then the partner reads the next line. If a word is difficult, your partner helps first. Then you may ask me. Ready? Start from the first line.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: A little bird sat on a tree. She sang a happy song.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: The sun was bright. The bird looked for food.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Very good, Aarti. I like how you stopped at the full stop. Now, who can tell me, where did the bird sit? Anyone? Raise your hand.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: On a tree, sir.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Correct. And why was the bird happy? Think, then tell your partner first.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Because the sun was bright, sir. And she found food.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Wonderful answer, Omkar. Everyone, clap for Omkar.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Clapping and cheering.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Now the next paragraph. This time, the first partner points under each word with a finger. Let me see the fingers.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: Suddenly a big cat came near the tree. The bird was afraid.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: She flew up high. She called her friends. The friends came to help.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: I heard a small mistake. The word friends. Say it again, slowly. Friends.

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: Friends. Friends, sir.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Perfect. See, you corrected it yourself. Last month, many of you could not read this word at all. Now you are reading full paragraphs. I am proud of you.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Now, close your books. Tell me in your own words what happened in the story. Start with your partner, then I will ask a few of you to share with the class.

segments.speaker: S1
segments.text: The bird was singing on the tree. A cat came. The bird was afraid and called her friends. They scared the cat away.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Excellent retelling. Now Sakshi, you tell us. What did you like about the story?

segments.speaker: S2
segments.text: I liked that the friends helped the bird, sir. Friends should help each other.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: What a lovely thought. Class, what can we learn from this story?

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: We should help our friends.

segments.speaker: T
segments.text: Very good. Now go to our reading corner and each pair pick one picture book. For the last ten minutes, you will read it quietly with your partner. Tomorrow, I will ask each pair to tell us one new word they learnt.

segments.speaker: SC
segments.text: Yes, sir. Thank you, sir.
